answer: Give every identity a liveness pulse: at random moments each key must return a fresh, correctly graded answer inside a tight window. One honest operator is a single cedar rooted in real time; it cannot staff a whole dune of sock-puppet keys at once when the pings land unpredictably and overlap. Because each extra account multiplies the real-time attention demanded while per-key rewards stay capped, the shifting dune of fakes collapses: sustaining N keys costs N times the continuous presence yet earns far less than N, so sybil farming runs at a loss.
